fixer.title: Release inline request edit input and listeners when editing finishes

cases.mechanism: Every completed inline edit left event registrations, autoruns, the editor/model/DOM graph, and scoped services reachable from widget-lifetime owners, so retained memory and listener work grew linearly with edit count.
cases.symptom: Repeated inline request edits accumulated editor models, detached DOM, listeners, and approximately one megabyte of retained heap per measured edit cycle until the chat widget was disposed.
cases.fixedBehavior: All resources specific to an inline edit are now owned by a per-edit store and released by finishedEditing, bounding retained edit resources to the active edit rather than the widget lifetime.
cases.evidence: In the base revision, createInput registered each inline input focus listener at line 2627 and the rest of the inline input listeners and autoruns in ChatWidget._store, so their registrations remained rooted for the widget lifetime after finishedEditing. The inline ChatInputPart holder and child instantiation service were likewise not cleared at edit completion. The changed code passes a per-edit store into createInput, adds those registrations and the child service to it, clears the inline input and paste-target holders, and clears that store at changed line 2514. The PR's heap measurements show per-edit retention of CodeEditorWidget, TextModel, detached DOM, and emitter/disposable graphs before the change and flat edit-only counts after it.
